title: [Main]- Lot-for-Lot accumulation splits supply into multiple requisition lines when Dampener Period and Safety Stock are enabled
summary: Fixed Lot-for-Lot accumulation in inventory planning to consolidate multiple requisition lines into one when both Dampener Period and Safety Stock are enabled.
key_points: Cause: within the dampener period, planning would not let a new order grow if it was smaller than the item's total safety stock
New orders suggested in the same planning run can now grow within the lot accumulation period
The whole need now goes on one requisition line instead of two split lines (for example 1 x 1,728 instead of 864 + 864)
The issue showed up for Lot-for-Lot items with both Dampener Period and Safety Stock set
Regression test added in SCM Planning tests
